integrity: The recurrence is derived directly from the published Hessian-corrected heavy-ball update. Necessary-and-sufficient Jury conditions prove the stability budget, and characteristic-root products prove the modewise rate optimum. The bundled replay checks representative cases but is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact deterministic constant-parameter analysis on symmetric positive-definite quadratics. The modewise rate optimum is not a minimax tuning theorem for nonisotropic spectra and does not extend directly to nonquadratic, nonnormal, adaptive, stochastic, or inexact settings.
title: Exact spectral stability budget and momentum cancellation for Hessian-corrected heavy ball
